meta_description: Chief Security Officer at Dataq Software — Owns the zero-exposure architecture, security operations and compliance posture.

blocks.x: The Chief Security Officer mandate at Dataq Software: keep deliveries predictable, keep evidence honest, and stay personally reachable to the clients those deliveries serve.

The build earns trust the same way every gate does: cost and quality telemetry land in the same view your owners read across the Chief Security Officer estate, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.

items: The design principle here is simple: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the Chief Security Officer estate, so your control owners can interrogate any number we publish.
